title: Planning checks
editorHelp: Optional visual checks. Missing-value checks can also require a field before completion when explicitly enabled.
noRules: Choose Missing value or Planning load to add your first check.
readError: Checks are unavailable. Existing tasks are unchanged.
limits: Up to 50 checks and 12 distinct custom fields. Checks cover at most 5,000 home-project tasks and 100 groups.
staleDraft: Settings changed while you were editing. Close and reopen to use the latest revision.
invalidRule: Complete the required settings and check the entered values.
presenceHelp: Empty values are highlighted. Zero and No count as filled values. Task editing and autosave remain available.
manualHelp: A manual target applies only to this check. It does not change the person’s schedule or Available hours in reports.
durationHelp: Enter hours, for example 40, 37.5 or 37:30. Values are stored as whole minutes.
missingPlan: When some planned values are missing
requireComplete: Show unknown until all values are filled
emptyStatusScope: No selected status groups means all statuses are included.
homeScope: Checks use all authorized tasks owned by this project, independently of the table’s filters and loaded pages. Linked tasks are excluded.
configureGroup: Configure planning checks for this group
allTaskCohort: Plan covers all matching tasks, not just the capacity period
differentPeriods: Plan and target use different periods
reviewHelp: All matching project tasks, with current access checked by the server. This list is independent of the loaded table.

reason.projectDatesMissing: Set project dates or choose another period

reviewProjectRule: {{rule}}: {{count}} matching tasks in this group. Open all matching tasks in this project.
overdueHelp: Highlights due dates after the workspace-local day. The default includes To do and In progress; included statuses are editable below.
paused: Checks are paused. Enable project checks to display warnings.
invalidConfig: Check settings exceed the limits or contain an invalid rule. Edit or remove the affected rule before saving.
readOnlyDraft: You no longer have permission to change these checks. Your draft and any unconfirmed save are preserved.
discardHelp: Your check settings have not been saved. Keep editing to preserve them, or discard these changes and close.
pendingCloseHelp: Your check settings are being saved. Please wait for the result before closing.
uncertainCloseHelp: The last save has not been confirmed. Retry the same save before closing so your changes are not lost or saved twice.
requireBeforeDone: Require this field before completing tasks
requireBeforeDoneHelp: Applies to matching tasks entering a Done status, including new tasks. Both project checks and this check must be enabled. Existing completed tasks remain editable; zero and No are accepted.
uncertainReadOnlyCloseHelp: The last save has not been confirmed, and your permission to change checks has been removed. Your original save is preserved. Ask a workspace owner to restore access, then retry the same save.
groupEntryHelp: This opens the project’s checks. Missing-value and overdue rules apply across the project; editing or removing them changes every matching task, including other sections. Group rules keep their selected section or person.
projectEntryHelp: Project-wide rules affect every matching task. Each planning-load rule names its own section or person.
sourceHelp: Choose your own field to total. Ordinary task values count each task once; personal effort also includes each shared participant. No field name or weekly period is required.
targetHelp: Compare this total with a number you set or, for duration fields, a person’s available working time. Target periods do not silently filter the tasks being totalled.
bandsSetupHelp: Choose a field and complete its comparison target before setting warning colors.
underBandLabel: Highlight when the total is below the target
overBandLabel: Highlight when the total is above the target
unsavedProjectChanges: Project changes are not saved yet. Save checks to apply them across the project.
templateOwnershipLoading: Checking which planning-load rules belong to linked summaries…
templateOwnershipUnavailable: Linked-summary ownership could not be checked. Project-wide reminders remain editable; reload before changing group rules.
templateOwnershipHelp: Open project checks to review this group’s linked-summary ownership before editing.
templateManagedHelp: Managed by “{{name}}”. Change or remove this check through that linked summary.
saveProjectBeforeTemplate: Save or discard your project changes before editing a linked summary.
templatePendingCloseHelp: The linked summary is being saved. Wait for the result before closing checks.
templateUncertainCloseHelp: The linked-summary save is unconfirmed. Keep this editor open and retry the original template command.
projectRuleEditHelp: This rule applies across the project. Saving also includes any project changes already made in this editor.
groupRuleEditHelp: Choose what to total and what to compare it with. Saving includes any project changes already made in this editor.
managedRuleDraftHelp: This group is controlled by a linked summary. Cancel this rule and use Edit linked summary to change its checks.
